speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have unusual behaviors regarding telepathic communication with animals; please describe exactly what these experiences entail and when they first began. To better understand the nature of these delusions, have you noticed any hallucinations, memory problems, or recent head injuries?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old male. The patient presents with a chief complaint of 'failing health.' He reports an inability to communicate telepathically with animals, which he believes he could previously do, affected by the current weather conditions. He has started taking assorted Peruvian herbs without any improvement. He denies taking any medications. The symptoms have been ongoing for the past eight months.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Delusional Disorder, Somatic Type (with themes of altered perception and failure of special ability).
